film.title: Learn Azure by building a trade finance risk pipeline: full course, beginner to professional
film.blurb: Every number is really computed, locally: PostgreSQL 18.6, Python 3.14.9 and PySpark 4.2.0 with Delta 4.4.1. Every Azure resource is Terraform. The Azure steps marked recorded were run once on a real subscription, their transcripts kept, then torn down. The rest says so on screen: emulated (Azurite), compiled (terraform validate, not deployed), doc-cited, or a model. Databricks is not run: open-source Spark and Delta stand in for it, labelled.
